asks: Does the model answer the question, and both one-hop questions, right?
what_happened: Two-hop: says “B” (right answer “B”, P = 0.89). Hop 1 “In which city was Roger Federer born? Answer in one word.” → “Basel”. Hop 2 “What letter does the word Basel start with? Answer with one letter.” → “B”.

asks: Is every edited word a single token?
what_happened: “Basel” are single tokens.

asks: Does removing the answer's own direction kill it, and from which layers?
what_happened: Remove the answer “B” itself: first kills it in layers 27–31 (P 0.89 → 0.01, drop 0.99). That's where the model starts writing the answer.

asks: Same question, asked to name the bridge first: does removing the bridge (before the answer onset) kill its name?
what_happened: Ask “What letter does the name of the city where Roger Federer was born start with? Answer with one letter. First name the city.” with the reply starting “The city is” (model continues: “Basel, which starts with the”). Remove “Basel” in layers 18–23 → P(“Basel”) goes 0.39 → 0.01. Drop 0.98.

asks: Does removing the bridge, before the answer onset, kill the answer?
what_happened: Remove “Basel” in layers 21–26 → P(“B”) goes 0.89 → 0.82. Drop 0.08.

asks: Is that drop bigger than removing everyday words of the same strength?
what_happened: Biggest drop from 12 everyday words: 0.12 (“lantern”, layers 18–23). Bridge 0.08 − noise 0.12 = -0.04 (pass ≥ 0.5).

asks: Does the bridge start to matter at least 3 layers before the answer does?
what_happened: “Basel” first matters from layer 27; the answer “B” from layer 27 → 0 layers earlier.

asks: Does removing the bridge matter more than removing another word of its kind with the same answer?
what_happened: Remove “Geneva” (same answer) → P(“B”) goes 0.89 → 0.84. Drop 0.06. Bridge 0.08 − 0.06 = 0.03 (pass ≥ 0.3).

asks: Does the same edit leave unrelated questions alone?
what_happened: Same edit (layers 21–26): “What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer in one word.” → P(“Au”) 1.00 → 1.00; “What is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer in one word.” → P(“Jupiter”) 0.95 → 0.95. Biggest drop 0.00 (pass ≤ 0.1).

asks: What if the bridge is removed over many layers at once?
what_happened: Remove “Basel” in layers 8–23 → P(“B”) 0.89 → 0.89 (drop 0.00); in all layers → 0.89 (drop 0.00).

asks: Does removing only the part of the bridge not shared with the answer still kill it?
what_happened: Remove “Basel” minus “B” (early layers) → P(“B”) 0.89 → 0.87. Drop 0.03.

asks: Swap in another word: does the answer become that word's answer?
what_happened: 0 of 7 swaps gave the swapped word's own answer (fallback answer with the bridge removed: “B”).

asks: Swap in a word with the same answer: is the answer kept?
what_happened: 1 of 1 kept the answer.

asks: Need × specificity × isolation (0 if the bridge doesn't come first)
what_happened: Need 0.00 (drop beyond noise) × specificity 0.32 (share not matched by a same-kind word) × isolation 0.30 (share left when the part shared with the answer is kept) = 0.00 → 0 because the bridge doesn't act before the answer.
